parts.name: Rear Brake
parts.description: A single hydraulic caliper on a 240 mm disc, with ABS, operated by the right foot pedal.
parts.function: Adds stopping power and stabilizes the bike, especially at low speed and in turns.

parts.name: Rear Brake Disc (240 mm)
parts.description: A 240 mm rotor on the rear hub. The diameter in the 3D view matches the Honda spec.
parts.function: The friction surface for the rear caliper.
parts.verificationNote: Search results gave conflicting 2026 part numbers for this disc, so none is recorded.

parts.name: Rear Brake Caliper
parts.description: A single hydraulic caliper at the rear wheel.
parts.function: Clamps the pads onto the rear disc when the pedal is pressed.
parts.verificationNote: The caliper type is Honda-published. Mounting and part number are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

parts.name: Rear Brake Pads
parts.description: Friction pads inside the rear caliper.
parts.function: Contact the rear disc to create braking force.

parts.name: Rear Brake Master Cylinder
parts.description: A pedal-operated master cylinder near the right footpeg, with its own reservoir.
parts.function: Turns pedal force into hydraulic pressure for the rear caliper.

parts.name: Rear Brake Line
parts.description: Hydraulic hose and pipe from the rear master cylinder through the ABS modulator to the rear caliper. The routing shown is representative.
parts.function: Carries pressurized brake fluid to the rear caliper.
